title: Send a photo from Photos
aliases: how do i share a photo from photos
send a picture from my photos
text someone a photo from my album
send a photo from my camera roll
share a picture with my family

steps.instruction: Tap the photo you want to send.
Tap the share icon, a square with an arrow pointing up.
Tap "Messages" in the row of apps.
Tap the matching person in the suggestions below "To:".
Tap the upward arrow beside the photo to send it.

source_note: Photos and Messages on iOS 26/27, English, October 2026 documentation review. Shares one saved photo through Messages to an existing contact. Assumes the photo grid is available and Messages is set up. The app row can be scrolled sideways; its order varies. Check the recipient field and send arrow in the sharing screen. Not checked on a phone. Sources: https://support.apple.com/en-nz/guide/iphone/iphf28f17237/27/ios/27 and https://support.apple.com/guide/iphone/iph82fb73ba3/26/ios/26
